title: [3.1.0.3] Basal history incorrect when importing parameters after clean install
symptom: After a clean install of AndroidAPS 3.1.0.3 and importing parameters from xDrip+ or Nightscout, the basal history is incorrect, showing full basal as if AMA was used instead of the lower SMB basal, causing a discrepancy in IOB (e.g., IOB 1.08 vs correct 0.37).
cause: The thread suggests that accepting TBR from NS is disabled in AAPS mode for safety reasons, which may explain why the imported basal history is not correct.
evidence_quote: yes, accepting TBR from NS is disabled in AAPS mode for safety reasons (it can be enabled only in engineering mode)
